verses.text: For the choirmaster: To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm of Asaph. A song. We give thanks to You, O God; we give thanks, for Your Name is near. The people declare Your wondrous works.

xrefs.text: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.
I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
For what nation is great enough to have a god as near to them as the LORD our God is to us whenever we call on Him?
Pay attention to him and listen to his voice; do not defy him, for he will not forgive rebellion, since My Name is in him.

verses.text: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.

xrefs.text: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked, since there is a time for every activity and every deed.”
For He has set a day when He will judge the world with justice by the Man He has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising Him from the dead.
Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor — the appointed time has come.

verses.text: When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah

xrefs.text: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap. He seats them among princes and bestows on them a throne of honor. For the foundations of the earth are the LORD’s, and upon them He has set the world.
The earth is utterly broken apart, the earth is split open, the earth is shaken violently.

The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature, upholding all things by His powerful word. After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.

This is what the LORD says: “In the time of favor I will answer You, and in the day of salvation I will help You; I will keep You and appoint You to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land, to apportion its desolate inheritances,
He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent He had pitched among men.

verses.text: I say to the proud, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.

xrefs.text: “What are these coming to do?” I asked. And He replied, “These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could raise his head; but the craftsmen have come to terrify them and throw down these horns of the nations that have lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
O simple ones, learn to be shrewd; O fools, gain understanding.
“How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?
He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
“How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah

verses.text: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”

xrefs.text: Now do not stiffen your necks as your fathers did. Submit to the LORD and come to His sanctuary, which He has consecrated forever. Serve the LORD your God, so that His fierce anger will turn away from you.
You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit, just as your fathers did.
For I knew that you are stubborn; your neck is iron and your forehead is bronze.
For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you are already rebelling against the LORD while I am still alive, how much more will you rebel after my death!
The LORD also said to Moses, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.

verses.text: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,

xrefs.text: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.

verses.text: but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.

xrefs.text: He has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.
He changes the times and seasons; He removes kings and establishes them. He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to the discerning.
The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.
He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
But David said to Michal, “I was dancing before the LORD, who chose me over your father and all his house when He appointed me ruler over the LORD’s people Israel. I will celebrate before the LORD,

verses.text: For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs.

xrefs.text: Let his eyes see his own destruction; let him drink for himself the wrath of the Almighty.
This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: “Take from My hand this cup of the wine of wrath, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink from it.
On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind will be their portion.
The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. And God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.
And a third angel followed them, calling out in a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,

verses.text: But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.

xrefs.text: that I may declare all Your praises— that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.

verses.text: “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”

xrefs.text: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
The horn of Moab has been cut off, and his arm is broken,” declares the LORD.
Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.
He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
